business_problem: Siemens needed to reduce the number of legacy employee-service systems and harmonize global business-service processes before it could scale AI-ready operations.
solution_summary: Siemens needed to reduce the number of legacy employee-service systems and harmonize global business-service processes before it could scale AI-ready operations. Siemens implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, Workflow Data Fabric, App Engine, and IT Service Management. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Workflow Data Fabric connects operational data and automation context; App Engine builds custom workflow apps; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations before ServiceNow AI Platform, Workflow Data Fabric, App Engine, and IT Service Management routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform. Running employee support and operational workflows on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.
